metadata.title: [AFP-1] Establish AWE Council & Fund Grants and Community Operations
metadata.description:
# [AFP-1] Establish AWE Council & Fund Grants and Community Operations 
### Summary

This proposal seeks to:

1. Ratify the AWE funding process by establishing clear thresholds and workflows for treasury usage.
2. Establish dedicated multisig wallet, managed by the AWE Council, for:

* Grants — supporting builders, games, research, and tools
* Community Operations — powering marketing, growth, partnerships, and events

This framework enables efficient, transparent funding of ecosystem initiatives while maintaining community oversight for larger disbursements.

***

### Ratified Funding Framework

To balance operational agility with decentralized governance, the following funding rules are proposed:

* **Disbursements under $100,000 USD (in AWE equivalent)**
  These can be approved and executed directly by the AWE Council through the appropriate multisig wallet (Grants or Community Operations).
  Examples include Layer3 campaigns, small grants, content bounties, or partnership incentives.
* **Disbursements equal to or above $100,000 USD**
  These must go through a separate AFP and be approved via onchain governance through Tally.
  This ensures large treasury allocations undergo transparent, community-driven approval.

***

### Rationale

As AWE grows, it must support a diverse set of builders, contributors, and campaign initiatives. Delays caused by requiring full proposals for all expenditures limit responsiveness. At the same time, community trust and capital allocation transparency remain critical.

This proposal introduces:

* Dedicated multisig wallet for Grants and Community Operations
* A clear funding threshold to streamline small initiatives
* Community governance checks for larger budget items
* Transparent reporting mechanisms and a formalized Council structure

***

### Establishing the AWE Council

The AWE Council will manage both multisig wallets, coordinate disbursements, and publish monthly financial reports.

* **Structure:** 5 members, managing both wallets
* **Threshold:** 3-of-5 multisig
* **Selection:** A follow-up **ACP (AWE Community Proposal)** will be submitted and voted on via **Snapshot** to nominate and confirm Council members. This ACP will define term lengths and eligibility criteria.
* The proposal has passed. The current council can be found on [Snapshot](https://snapshot.box/#/s:stp.eth/proposal/0x06b1084f6e21ca96f8773a4104eda76bff1f8db3874a6fd0fb64b83829b25f7b). 

***

### Budget Allocation

**Builder grants** - 2,500,000 AWE

**Community grants** - 2,500,000 AWE

**Total Requested:** 5,000,000 AWE
This budget is intended to support Q3 2025 operations, with a performance review and potential replenishment via a follow-up AFP.

***

### Multisig Setup

* **Platform:** Gnosis Safe on Base
* **Threshold:** 3-of-5
* **Signers:** Confirmed via [Snapshot](https://snapshot.box/#/s:stp.eth/proposal/0x06b1084f6e21ca96f8773a4104eda76bff1f8db3874a6fd0fb64b83829b25f7b)
* **Address**: `0x402bcD26b44FE8f3C88Bbb987c05a264218B2d1b`

***

### Fund Management & Transparency

**Grants Wallet:**

* Monthly open RFPs and rolling applications
* All grants under $100K processed by Council
* Public grantee list, milestone tracking, and monthly Mirror reports

**Community Wallet:**

* Used for growth campaigns, activations, creator bounties, and partnerships
* Real-time public budget tracker
* Monthly summaries and quarterly reviews

**For any funding request ≥ $100,000 USD:**
A full AFP must be submitted and passed via Tally before disbursement.

***

### Timeline

* Week 1: ACP is submitted and voted on via Snapshot to ratify AWE Council, create Multisig wallet
* Week 2/3: AFP voting on Tally
* Week 4: Wallets funded
* Month 1–3: Funds deployed, monthly reporting begins
* End of Q3: Treasury review and potential replenishment AFP

metadata.title: [AFP-0B] Test Proposal: Treasury Transfer With Security Council Intervention
metadata.description:
# [AFP-0B] Test Proposal: Treasury Transfer With Security Council Intervention
### Summary

This proposal initiates a test transfer of **100 AWE** from the AWE Treasury to a designated Gnosis Safe multisig wallet on Base. It will **bypass the standard Ideation and Temp Check phases** and proceed directly to onchain submission via Tally.

Unlike AFP-0, this proposal is designed to **test the Security Council’s ability to counter-sign and reject execution** after the proposal has passed, simulating a post-vote safeguard intervention.

***

### Rationale

This test is part of a comprehensive validation of AWE’s governance and security stack. It specifically tests the **execution gating mechanism**, where the Security Council may step in to halt proposals that have already passed onchain voting but present technical or strategic risk.

Objectives:

* Confirm standard proposal flow through Tally and Timelock
* Simulate successful passage of a proposal that should not be executed
* Validate that the Security Council can intervene and prevent execution
* Ensure multisig-level veto mechanisms function as expected

***

### Requested Transfer

* **Amount:** 100 AWE
* **Recipient Wallet:** `0x950a3801d42A782e71B7ED2a46557666adcc92d5`
  *(Gnosis Safe on Base)*

***

### Execution Plan

* Proposal will be submitted directly to Tally
* Onchain voting period: 10 days
* Standard 7-day timelock
* **Security Council will reject the transaction** during or after the timelock to prevent execution

This will confirm that even passed proposals can be halted safely if needed.

***

### Notes

* This proposal is strictly for testing and will not result in fund movement
* The rejection process will be transparently documented and confirmed publicly
* This test is critical for testing the DAO’s defense and review infrastructure

***

### Call to Action

Community members and delegates are encouraged to vote on-chain once the proposal is live on Tally.

This test ensures that, in future high-stakes scenarios, the AWE governance system has working fail-safes in place to protect the treasury and protocol integrity.

metadata.title: [AFP-0] Test Proposal To Transfer 100 AWE from Treasury to Multisig Wallet
metadata.description:
# [AFP-0] Test Proposal To Transfer 100 AWE from Treasury to Multisig Wallet 
### Summary

This proposal initiates a one-time **test transfer of 100 AWE** from the AWE Treasury to a designated Gnosis Safe multisig wallet on Base. It will **bypass the standard Ideation and Temp Check phases** to expedite execution and validate the onchain governance flow.

***

### Rationale

This is a technical test to confirm the functionality of the AWE onchain governance system on Tally. Before proceeding with larger treasury proposals, it’s critical to validate:

* Proposal submission and formatting
* Treasury execution of token transfers
* Timelock functionality and transaction triggering
* Safe receipt of funds by a Gnosis multisig

This test will provide full-cycle confirmation of the governance tooling and execution environment.

***

### Requested Transfer

* **Amount:** 100 AWE
* **Recipient Wallet:** `0x950a3801d42A782e71B7ED2a46557666adcc92d5`
  *(Gnosis Safe on Base)*

***

### Execution Plan

* Proposal will be submitted directly to Tally without Ideation or Temp Check
* Onchain voting period: 10 days
* Timelock: 7 days post-vote (standard)
* Once the timelock expires, the transfer may be triggered by any wallet on Base

***

### Notes

* This is a non-material, technical validation proposal
* No further spending or operational authority is granted by this proposal
* Successful execution will confirm the readiness of the DAO’s governance infrastructure

***

### Call to Action

This is a foundational step for the AWE governance system. Community members and delegates are encouraged to vote on-chain once the proposal is live on Tally.

If successful, this will mark the first executed AFP and open the door for larger treasury operations to proceed with confidence.
